topics.title: Metalyse Late Time Window China Sister Trial – HAI (Pre-IND) Interaction Strategy

background.text: BUPC decision on 11 Dec 2025: Global recommends submitting the CTA directly without prior CDE consultation. The regulatory strategy for the China sister trial is pending CN RA agreement.
background.quote:
The decision from BUPC (11 Dec 2025)

Global recommends submitting the CTA directly, without prior CDE consultation.

The regulatory strategy for the China sister trial is pending CN RA agreement.

background.text: Local team's current proposal (Pre-IND consultation) is not aligned with BUPC recommendations; guidance from PEC members is requested.
background.quote:
Current proposal from the local team is not aligned with BUPC recommendations.
2.Guidance from PEC members is requested.

background.text: Local assessment: Pre-IND is necessary due to complexity of the current development strategy.
background.quote: Pre-IND is necessary, due to the complexity of the current development strategy.

background.text: Local assessment pros of Pre-IND (value): opportunity for in-depth communication & alignment with CDE on overall development strategy; mitigates potential NDA approval risk at early stage; no cons identified.
background.quote: With Pre-IND | PROS: Value: An opportunity for in-depth communication & alignment with CDE on overall development strategy. Mitigate potential risk for NDA approval at early stage | CONS: None

background.text: Local assessment pros of Pre-IND (timeline): proactively identify and resolve potential issues; no impact to following sister trial process (placebo preparation is on critical path).
background.quote: Proactively identify and resolve potential issues to minimize timeline impact on overall development plan. Meanwhile, no impact to following sister trial process. (placebo preparation is on critical path)

background.text: Local assessment cons of Without Pre-IND: lose opportunity for in-depth communication with CDE on overall development strategy, leaving significant uncertainty for NDA approval.
background.quote: Without Pre-IND | PROS: Save limited resource for pre-IND preparation | CONS: Lose opportunity for in-depth communication with CDE on overall development strategy to leave a significant uncertainty for NDA-approval.

background.text: Additional con of Without Pre-IND: queries during CTA stage might be challenging and may impact following timeline.
background.quote: Queries during CTA stage might be challenging and may impact following timeline

for_endorsement.text: Slide 1 marks this item as 'For Endorsement'; the team proposes PEC endorse the HAI (Pre-IND consultation) strategy for the Metalyse Late Time Window China sister trial.
